Kim / Marissa — see answers below (pulling the concise bullets you can drop into the SIG spreadsheet). I’ve also attached an architecture snapshot and the backup policy excerpt.

- Target RTO / RPO:
  * Hosted API (standard tier): RTO = 30 minutes for control-plane failures (failover to standby control plane), RPO = 5 minutes (semi-continuous metadata replication).
  * Hosted API (critical/high-tier customers): RTO = 5 minutes for control-plane failover (reserved control-plane capacity), RPO = 1 minute with accelerated replication.
  * Dedicated / Private: RTO/RPO are contract-specific; default guidance: RTO = 2 hours, RPO = 15 minutes unless SLA states otherwise.

- Backups / retention / location:
  * Configuration & metadata: incremental snapshots every 5 minutes, retained 90 days; primary storage in us-west-2 with geo-replication to us-east-1.
  * Model artifacts: object-store snapshots (immutable manifests) every 6 hours; retained 365 days for production models. Model binaries are stored as immutable manifests + checksum; full cross-region replicate within 24 hours.
  * Customer-managed Private deployments: advise customers to configure their own backup targets per policy; Redwood provides backup hooks and a recommended S3 layout.

- Automated failover / regional failover steps:
  * Automated health checks detect region outage -> traffic routed to compatible region via Smart Routing layer (policy-driven).
  * Control-plane failover: automatic promotion of warm-standby in <5–30 minutes depending on tier (see RTO bullets).
  * Model-serving failover: serving nodes maintain KV cache warm-start where possible; cold-start model load may take additional time based on model size (e.g., 70B models: 6–12 minutes to reach warm state from cold storage under current speedups).

- Runbooks / playbooks / DR tests:
  * Runbooks: internal runbook repo (attached excerpt) with step-by-step playbooks for region failover, certificate reissue, and capacity expansion.
  * DR tests: quarterly tabletop + semi-annual full failover test; last full DR run: 2026-08-14 (successful; <target RTO for standard tier, one rollback test noted on model-cache warm-up that completed in 9 minutes).

Attachments included: redwood-prod-bcdr-arch.png, backup-policy-2026-10.pdf

If you want, I can add a short note on model-size-dependent warm-up times to the spreadsheet.

—Rishi
